nodes.summary: For every group $G$ of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane, the underlying set of the translation lattice subgroup of $G$ is the translation lattice of $G$.
nodes.title: Carrier of the translation lattice subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $g$ be an affine isometry of the Euclidean plane with linear part $A$, let $v$ be a vector, and write $\tau_w$ for translation by a vector $w$. Then $g \circ \tau_v \circ g^{-1} = \tau_{A v}$.
nodes.title: Conjugating a translation by a plane isometry

nodes.summary: Every discrete additive subgroup `G` of `ℝ²` is trivial, cyclic (generated by a single nonzero vector), or a rank-two lattice (generated by two `ℝ`-linearly independent vectors).
nodes.title: Classification of discrete additive subgroups of the plane

nodes.summary: $E_2$ is the Euclidean plane: the real vector space $\mathbb{R}^2$ of pairs of real numbers with the standard Euclidean inner product and norm.
nodes.title: The Euclidean plane for discrete isometry groups

nodes.summary: A group $G$ of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane satisfies the separation criterion if there is $\varepsilon > 0$ such that every element $f \ne \mathrm{id}$ of $G$ whose linear part is the identity satisfies $\|f(0)\| \ge \varepsilon$, and every element $f$ of $G$ whose linear part $A$ is not the identity satisfies $\|A - I\| \ge \varepsilon$, where $I$ is the identity map and the norm is the operator norm.
nodes.title: Separation criterion for groups of plane isometries

nodes.summary: The linear part of an affine isometry $f$ of the Euclidean plane is the linear isometry $A$ of the plane such that $f(x + v) = f(x) + A v$ for every point $x$ and every vector $v$.
nodes.title: Linear part of a plane isometry

nodes.summary: $M_2$ is the group, under composition, of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane onto itself.
nodes.title: Isometry group of the Euclidean plane

nodes.summary: For every group $G$ of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane and every vector $v$ of the plane, $v$ belongs to the translation lattice subgroup of $G$ if and only if $v$ belongs to the translation lattice of $G$.
nodes.title: Membership in the translation lattice subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane. If $A$ belongs to the point group of $G$, that is, $A$ is the linear part of some element of $G$, and $v$ belongs to the translation lattice of $G$, then $A v$ belongs to the translation lattice of $G$.
nodes.title: The point group preserves the translation lattice

nodes.summary: The point group of a group $G$ of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane is the set of linear parts of the elements of $G$.
nodes.title: Point group of a group of plane isometries

nodes.summary: For vectors $v$ and $w$ of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$, if translation by $v$ and translation by $w$ are the same affine isometry, then $v = w$. Equivalently, the translation homomorphism $v \mapsto (x \mapsto v + x)$ from the additive group of the plane to the group of affine isometries of the plane is injective.
nodes.title: Translations are determined by their vectors

nodes.summary: The group homomorphism from the additive group of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$ (written multiplicatively) to the group of affine isometries of the plane that sends a vector $v$ to translation by $v$, the isometry $x \mapsto v + x$.
nodes.title: Translation homomorphism

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$, and suppose there is $\varepsilon > 0$ such that every non-identity translation in $G$ moves the origin by at least $\varepsilon$, and every element of $G$ whose linear part $A$ is not the identity satisfies $\|A - I\| \ge \varepsilon$ in operator norm. Let $L$ be the translation lattice of $G$, the additive subgroup of vectors $v$ such…
nodes.title: Classification of translation lattices

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$, and suppose there is $\varepsilon > 0$ such that every non-identity translation in $G$ moves the origin by at least $\varepsilon$, and every element of $G$ whose linear part $A$ is not the identity satisfies $\|A - I\| \ge \varepsilon$ in operator norm. Then the translation lattice of $G$, the additive subgroup of vectors $v$ such that…
nodes.title: The translation lattice of a discrete isometry group is discrete

nodes.summary: For a group $G$ of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$, the additive subgroup of $\mathbb{R}^2$ consisting of the vectors $v$ such that translation by $v$ belongs to $G$; it is the preimage of $G$ under the translation homomorphism $v \mapsto (x \mapsto v + x)$.
nodes.title: Translation lattice as an additive subgroup

nodes.summary: The translation lattice of a subgroup $G$ of the group $M_2$ of affine isometries of the Euclidean plane $E_2$ is the set of vectors $v \in E_2$ such that the translation $x \mapsto v + x$ belongs to $G$.
nodes.title: Translation lattice

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
